summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 23, 2026 press release announcing publication of three U.S. patent applications covering LSD, ketamine and ibogaine combinations with N-acylethanolamines such as PEA, licensed from NeuroThera Labs. The applications target depression, PTSD, pain and substance use disorders. No transaction, securities offer, shareholder action or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report incorporated by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. No deal terms, advisors, stakes or regulatory clocks are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
